  children={"List the handling policies"}

</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/exception-policies"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists the current policy version of every declared source type,
ordered by source type, one page at a time (`limit`, `cursor`; keyset
on source type). An empty result is `200` with `{"items": []}`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
